careMethodsFeature.heading: Keep every kind of feed in one clear history.
paragraphs: Track breastfeeding, bottle feeds, pumping, and combined feeds in the same history, so you can see what was recorded without switching between separate logs.
When you record expressed milk, pumping adds to the on-device balance and expressed bottle feeds subtract from it. Leave volume blank when you did not record it.

historyFeature.heading: Update your log when you have time.
paragraphs: If your baby latched before you remembered the timer, move the start time back. If the feed is already over, add it when you have a moment.

faqs.question: How long can I use the app?
faqs.answer: It is designed to reduce the mental load of tracking feeds during the early newborn weeks. Keep using it for as long as it remains helpful.

faqs.question: Can I use Apple Watch when my iPhone isn’t nearby?
faqs.answer: You can start and stop the timer from your wrist without your iPhone nearby. Completed sessions sync when your devices reconnect.

faqs.question: Can I add or correct a feed after it happened?
faqs.answer: Feed history supports adding, editing, and deleting entries. If a feed began before you started the timer, you can move the recorded start time back.

faqs.question: Can I share feed history with a midwife?
faqs.answer: You can create a PDF from selected feed history and choose where to save or share it. The PDF only reflects what you recorded and is not a clinical report or a substitute for professional care.

faqs.question: Does the app require an account or subscription?
faqs.answer: No account or subscription is required. The app is free to download, with an optional one-off lifetime unlock.

faqs.question: Does the tracker provide medical advice?
faqs.answer: The tracker records only the details you enter, such as timing, duration, and breast side. Its private on-device summaries are informational and do not assess feeding or replace professional care.
